families.repro: Danse Macabre 'you may pay {r}{r} and {t} this. If you do, that ally's first attack gets go again and destroy that ally at the beginning of the end phase': accepting the optional applies the mixed resources+tap-self pay (tap + RP legs proven in equipment/danse-macabre.test.ts), but the if-you-do then-branch never stages. proposeOptional gates the continuation on the principal effect reporting committed events (rules/proposals/effects/optional.ts mainSucceeded), and the mixed pay leg returns none — neither the grantKeyword(goAgain, attacksOf binding) (probed: Barnacle's attack layer shows only watery-grave, AP stays 0 through the refund window) nor the windowed end-phase destroy on the binding (probed: ally still in arena after endTurn) manifests.
